proves: Professional PDF preview data is derived from a canonical PdfReportPlan before PDF byte generation.
SCR-PDF-BUILDER-001 exposes canonical ACTION-PDF-BUILDER-PREVIEW with semantics and a 48dp minimum interaction target.
The create action is disabled until a current preflight preview exists.
Changing the selected record or any report section invalidates the preview and blocks stale-plan generation.
Preview and build share the same canonical record ID, tr/en locale and ordered canonical PDF section IDs.
The UI now uses PdfSectionIds.customNotes instead of the non-canonical notes identifier.
Preview preserves section order, locale, cover style, A4 page specification and branding presence.
release_blockers: Exact Flutter/CI success evidence is still required before these requirements can be marked DONE.
Full final UI visual-regression approval remains a separate release gate.
